description:
Cast Magister Sphinx by paying {4}{W}{U}{B}.
Magister Sphinx enters the battlefield, causing target opponent's life total to become 10.
Cast Aria of Flame by paying {2}{R}.
Aria of Flame enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 10 life due to Plague Drone.
The opponent who was targeted in step 2 loses the game due to having zero life.
